name: grade-slider
does: A before/after slider tilted 8 degrees splits the frame through the face (BEFORE / AFTER tags), the knob takes a small press and the line steps further over the face on the nudge word, then the new look sweeps across the whole frame on the sweep word; GRADES takes the look over on the cut at B.
use_when: a look change the line asks for ('make it warmer', 'a touch warmer', 'it warms up'): any grade, named in LOOKS or a CSS filter
inputs: a GRADES entry for the new look starting at B, no fade: (B, <until>, LOOK)
where the split crosses the face (FACE: three [s, x, y] samples measured on stills; the code uses x, y)
the nudge and sweep cues (T.nudge, T.sweep: seconds after A or the spoken words)

notes.LOOK: warm or moody (build.py LOOKS), or a CSS filter list; it is read off the timeline at B so the sweep lands on exactly the grade that holds
notes.FACE: [seconds after A, x, y] where the line should cross the face: after the glide, at the nudge, at the sweep (eyes height); the default is a still, centred face
notes.T: slide and nudgeDur, sweepDur are lengths (s); labels, nudge and sweep are beats (nudge, sweep can be spoken words)
notes.HANDLE_Y: the knob's height on the line: keep it on the body, clear of the pack's caption box

needs: GRADES: ({end}, <until>, "{=LOOK}") the same LOOK, no fade, so the cut hands over invisibly
